title: The Chinese Communist Party holds its first congress
summary: A small group of delegates, including Mao Zedong, met secretly in Shanghai's French Concession for the first national congress of the Chinese Communist Party.
reason: Inspired by the Russian Revolution and supported by the Comintern, Chinese radicals sought to organize a Marxist party.
significance: The party it founded went on to rule China from 1949.
